title: WormTagDB: A Systematic Survey of Endogenously Tagged Proteins in C. elegans and Roadmap Towards the Tagged Proteome
authors: Leyhr J; Chi Q; Zeng L; Shen E; Zou W; Sherwood D
one_liner_zh: 该文系统综述线虫内源蛋白标签资源，虽涉及转录因子但无蛋白-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，仅属资源数据库建设，与课题核心关联弱。
abstract: Endogenous protein tagging in Caenorhabditis elegans enables direct visualization and manipulation of proteins in vivo, providing native readouts of expression, localization, and dynamics. No coordinated effort currently exists to comprehensively tag proteins on a large scale, resulting in patchy coverage that limits comprehensive proteome analyses. We systematically reviewed 2,500 primary research articles, identifying 778 that report novel endogenous tags, and integrated these with the Caenorhabditis Genetics Center strain records to catalog >90% of all existing tagged alleles. In total, we found that 1,554 unique genes (~8% of the proteome) have been endogenously tagged. Gene Ontology enrichment analysis revealed that cytoskeletal proteins, transcription factors, and RNA-binding proteins dominate the tagged proteome, while membrane proteins, metabolic enzymes, and mitochondrial components remain largely untagged, reflecting both technical barriers and research priorities that have shaped the last decade of tagging efforts. We created WormTagDB (https://wormtagdb.rc.duke.edu), an interactive, community-updatable resource that consolidates all known endogenously tagged alleles and provides precomputed CRISPR guide and homology-arm primer designs for N- and C-terminal knock-ins across all protein-coding genes. This will enable researchers to easily identify existing alleles to prevent redundant strain generation and rapidly initiate new knock-in experiments. A systematic effort to tag every C. elegans gene would deliver the first complete metazoan visual proteome, providing comprehensive insights into protein localization, dynamics, and regulation, revealing new protein associations and molecular processes.
abstract_zh: 秀丽隐杆线虫（Caenorhabditis elegans）中的内源性蛋白标记能够实现体内蛋白质的直接可视化和操作，提供表达、定位和动态的原生读数。目前尚无协调一致的努力来大规模全面标记蛋白质，导致覆盖不完整，限制了全面的蛋白质组分析。我们系统性地审阅了2,500篇原始研究文章，识别出778篇报告了新型内源性标签，并将这些与秀丽隐杆线虫遗传学中心（Caenorhabditis Genetics Center）的品系记录整合，以编目超过90%的现有标记等位基因。总体而言，我们发现1,554个独特基因（约占蛋白质组的8%）已被内源性标记。基因本体（Gene Ontology）富集分析显示，细胞骨架蛋白、转录因子和RNA结合蛋白在标记蛋白质组中占主导地位，而膜蛋白、代谢酶和线粒体组分则大多未被标记，这反映了过去十年标记工作中形成的技术障碍和研究重点。我们创建了WormTagDB（https://wormtagdb.rc.duke.edu），这是一个交互式、社区可更新的资源库，整合了所有已知的内源性标记等位基因，并为所有蛋白质编码基因的N端和C端敲入提供了预计算的CRISPR引导RNA和同源臂引物设计。这将使研究人员能够轻松识别现有等位基因，以避免冗余品系生成，并迅速启动新的敲入实验。对每个线虫基因进行系统性标记的努力将提供首个完整的后生动物视觉蛋白质组，为蛋白质定位、动态和调控提供全面见解，揭示新的蛋白质关联和分子过程。
